title: Student V0.1 JOB 01 R2 — SVG media policy alignment
purpose: Correct the JOB01 runtime SVG admission false-positive for standards-compliant namespace declarations while preserving fail-closed rejection of active and external SVG references, then requalify the exact role result for FAN-IN A R2.
invariants: The frozen v4 contract is unchanged.
A standards-compliant inline SVG namespace declaration is not treated as an executable or external media reference.
External href/xlink:href/src references, active URI schemes, scripts, event handlers and external url() references remain fail-closed.
The correction is owned by JOB01 runtime media admission; JOB03 authoring output is not modified to fit the bug.
v2 and v3 semantics remain unchanged.
Lesson/flashcard non-scored behavior and learner-safe secret boundaries remain unchanged.
PR #387 and its frozen predecessor SHA are not mutated.
requiredEvidence: Valid inline SVG containing xmlns=http://www.w3.org/2000/svg is admitted.
The exact representative JOB03 media case from a90ba85857dded331e5e3952c2f181cbe2e6d689 is admitted unchanged by corrected JOB01 runtime.
Existing malicious SVG cases remain rejected and new namespace-vs-reference adversarial cases pass.
JOB01 role qualification passes on the exact result head.
v2 regression and v3 constructed regression pass.
v4 evaluated and non-scored semantics pass.
Changed paths are a subset of allowedPaths.
The result is published on a new DRAFT PR without moving PR #387.
adversarialTests: Globally allowing http: or https: anywhere in SVG fails review.
Allowing external href, xlink:href or src references fails review.
Allowing script, foreignObject, iframe, object, embed, link, meta, style, animate, set or event-handler execution fails review.
Allowing external url() references fails review.
Changing authoring, UI, workflows, source manifest or v4 schema fails scope.
Changing unrelated JOB01 runtime semantics fails scope.
nonGoals: Changing learner UI sanitization or rendering.
Adding a generic SVG parser framework or third-party dependency without a demonstrated need.
Launching FAN-IN A R2, Wave 2, product promotion or student use.
independentReview: The defect was discovered by JOB04 cross-role qualification, not by JOB01 self-review.
JOB03 exact frozen output is used as read-only compatibility evidence.
A future FAN-IN A R2 must independently recombine the new JOB01 result with unchanged JOB02/JOB03 exact heads.
rollback: Close the JOB01 R2 PR and delete its branch. PR #387 remains frozen at d937592fb4d1e6dba6fcd02e290290f1a98cff71 and FAN-IN A remains on HOLD.
